# context-inbox

> A framework for turning messages from any source into cited changes in any destination. An agent drafts each change, a person approves it on a claude.ai review page, and the next run writes only approved changes.

Each project keeps a folder in a separate private repo: `config.json`, `RULES.md`, a reader per source and a guide per destination. The config maps channels to destinations.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): set up a project, the reader and guide formats, and the daily run.
- [RULES.md](RULES.md): what a proposal is, how to write it, and its JSON shape.

## Example project folder

- [example/config.json](example/config.json): one Slack source feeding one Linear destination.
- [example/RULES.md](example/RULES.md): people, what counts, what goes where.
- [example/readers/slack.py](example/readers/slack.py): Slack reader, thread replies included.
- [example/guides/linear.md](example/guides/linear.md): how to write to Linear.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): overview and manual setup for people.
- [review.html](review.html): the review page.
